title: Unencumbered
wikitext:
A character or {{il|Animate Guardian}} is considered '''unencumbered''' if their main hand, off-hand, and glove slots are all either empty or [[equipment|disabled]]. The unencumbered state is considered a stricter version of the [[unarmed]] state. 

The unencumbered state does not grant any inherent stats and is not considered a [[buff]]. It is a pre-requisite to benefit from certain stats.

Unarmed attacks normally count as using the main hand. While Unencumbered does not ''inherently'' change this, {{psl|Hollow Palm Technique}}'s {{c|mod|You count as Dual Wielding while Unencumbered}} will cause unarmed attacks to alternate hands.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/fcflyy/with_the_new_hollow_palm_technique_how_would/fjbbeyy/?context=1</ref> Note this is not necessarily accurately reflected by the character's visual animation.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/fnygra/comment/flcdq5l/</ref>

Players may wish to disable auto-pickup in the options menu to prevent accidentally equipping a weapon, shield, or gloves, disabling the unencumbered state.
